newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ cuts key business rate to 8.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ cuts key business rate to 8.95 pct.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Thursday that it will reduce its business reference rate to 8.95 percent from 9.35 percent, effective June 30.

A spokeswoman for the "Big Four" Australian bank said ANZ had not earlier announced a cut in business rates alongside reductions in housing rates. These reductions were in response to the 50 basis point reduction in the official cash rate to 5.5 percent announced by the Reserve Bank last Friday.

The ANZ's reduction in its prime business rates brings it in line with the Commonwealth Bank of Australia Ltd but above the 8.75 percent rate offered by Westpac Banking Corp. National Australia Bank Ltd has a 9.10 percent rate for major corporate customers who receive loans of more than A$100,000.
ANZ is the only major bank to have entirely passed on the full central bank easing to its housing customers.
The Federal government has criticised the failure of banks to pass on the full amount.
ANZ said it had also reduced its retail index rate by the full amount to 9.25 percent, from June 30, and the business mortgage loan rate to 7.4 percent from June 2.
